States 'two supporting' candidate excerpts; the record shows three proposed_stance supports.
The Hong 2019 'claimed quote' text is not in the record.

raw.verdict: D and B both grounded their answers in the recorded calls and reached the same calibrated conclusion: lean-mass loss is plausible at class level, but there is no human semaglutide effect size. D went further than B. It quantified the trend, exported the tally, and caught the corpus's own anomalies, including the mismatched subject headings term, the off-topic documents and the source-fit failures. A and C were honest memory syntheses; C gives the more expert-recognisable picture, but neither can be traced or reproduced.
